units: SI; x east, y north; grade is rise over run (tan of the slope angle)
model: A balance budget (0-1) that the ground's demand spends. load = speed_weight*speed/speed_ref_mps + slope_weight*grade/hold_grade; above 1 it drains at drain_per_s*(load-1), below 1 it refills at regen_per_s*(1-load). Low budget stumbles, an empty one trips, a trip on a slope or at speed tumbles, a tumble slows into a slide, a slide stops into a recovery, and a recovery stands up, or rolls on where no one could stand. A tuck rolls on purpose and cannot fail.
